about: architectures of lpac_study/variants.py; parameter counts are read from the run_info.json of a training run of each

V0.label: LPAC (the authors' architecture)
V0.description: CNN on four 32 x 32 maps, five TAGConv layers, MLP; the two neighbour-map channels are drawn at the scale of the communication range.
V0.map_input: 2 neighbour-map channels at the scale of the range (or at a fixed 256 m scale for experiment A)
V0.aggregation: TAGConv, K = 3: normalized sum over neighbours, 5 layers
training_sets: authors' release (published)
128 m, 100k samples generated with the authors' recipe
mixed ranges, 25k samples each at 128, 256, 512 and 1024 m

V1.label: V1: no neighbour map
V1.description: LPAC with the two neighbour-map channels removed; the robots only learn about each other through the graph.
V1.aggregation: TAGConv, K = 3: normalized sum over neighbours, 5 layers
training_sets: 128 m, 100k samples generated with the authors' recipe
V1.epochs: 100 (30 for the K = 1 control of Q3)

V2.label: V2: GATv2 with edge geometry
V2.description: No neighbour map; five GATv2 layers read (p_j - p_i) / W on every edge. Underfits as first trained (journal 10 and 16.3).
V2.edge_features: (p_j - p_i) / W, 2 numbers, W the world size
V2.aggregation: GATv2 softmax attention, 4 heads, 5 layers, no residual, no normalization
training_sets: 128 m, 100k samples generated with the authors' recipe

V2B.label: V2B: V2 with bounded edge features only
V2B.description: V2 with only the edge input replaced by V4's bounded features; the single-cause ablation of Q3. Trains exactly like V2.
V2B.aggregation: GATv2 softmax attention, 4 heads, 5 layers, no residual, no normalization
training_sets: 128 m, 100k samples generated with the authors' recipe

V2R.label: V2res: GATv2 in residual blocks
V2R.description: V2 with pre-norm residual blocks, LayerNorm and bounded edge features; removes V2's underfitting (journal 16.3, 16.4).
V2R.aggregation: GATv2 softmax attention, 4 heads, in x + relu(GATv2(LayerNorm(x))) blocks, 5 layers (15 in V2deep)
training_sets: 128 m, 100k samples generated with the authors' recipe

V2RL.label: V2logdeg: V2res plus log-degree
V2RL.description: V2res with log(1 + in-degree) added to the node input, to restore the neighbour count that attention averages away. Slightly worse than V2res.
training_sets: 128 m, 100k samples generated with the authors' recipe

V2M.label: V2M: V2res with max aggregation
V2M.description: V2res with each GATv2 layer replaced by the same GATv2-style message, leaky_relu(W_l x_i + W_r x_j + W_e e_ij), max-aggregated instead of softmax-weighted. Fits better than TAGConv and halves V2res's range degradation (journal 21).
V2M.aggregation: max over neighbours of GATv2-style messages, in x + relu(conv(LayerNorm(x))) blocks, 5 layers
training_sets: 128 m, 100k samples generated with the authors' recipe

V3.label: V3: PointNet edges
V3.description: V1 plus one PointNet-style layer in front of the TAGConv stack, reading (p_j - p_i) / 256 m on every edge.
V3.aggregation: max over neighbours in the front layer (residual), then TAGConv, K = 3: normalized sum over neighbours, 5 layers
training_sets: 128 m, 100k samples generated with the authors' recipe
mixed ranges, 25k samples each at 128, 256, 512 and 1024 m

V4.label: V4: bounded edge features
V4.description: V3 with bounded, range-invariant edge features: the unit direction to the neighbour and a squashed distance. Trained on mixed ranges it is the only model whose cost falls with the range.
V4.edge_features: [(p_j - p_i) / d, tanh(d / 256 m)], 3 numbers in [-1, 1]
V4.aggregation: max over neighbours in the front layer (residual), then TAGConv, K = 3: normalized sum over neighbours, 5 layers
training_sets: 128 m, 100k samples generated with the authors' recipe
mixed ranges, 25k samples each at 128, 256, 512 and 1024 m

V5.label: V5: multi-scale fixed maps
V5.description: LPAC with three pairs of neighbour-map channels at fixed scales of 256, 512 and 1024 m instead of one pair at the scale of the range.
V5.map_input: 6 neighbour-map channels at fixed scales 256 / 512 / 1024 m
V5.aggregation: TAGConv, K = 3: normalized sum over neighbours, 5 layers
training_sets: 128 m, 100k samples generated with the authors' recipe
mixed ranges, 25k samples each at 128, 256, 512 and 1024 m

V6.label: V6: V5 maps plus the V4 layer
V6.description: The multi-scale maps of V5 feeding the CNN and the bounded-edge front layer of V4. Equals V5 in cost: the two gains do not add up.
V6.map_input: 6 neighbour-map channels at fixed scales 256 / 512 / 1024 m
V6.edge_features: [(p_j - p_i) / d, tanh(d / 256 m)], 3 numbers in [-1, 1]
V6.aggregation: max over neighbours in the front layer (residual), then TAGConv, K = 3: normalized sum over neighbours, 5 layers
training_sets: mixed ranges, 25k samples each at 128, 256, 512 and 1024 m

V0R.label: V0R: own range as GNN input
V0R.description: LPAC with each robot's own communication range as an extra GNN input, trained on teams with a range drawn per robot.
V0R.map_input: 2 neighbour-map channels at the scale of the robot's own range
V0R.aggregation: TAGConv, K = 3: normalized sum over neighbours, 5 layers
training_sets: per-robot ranges drawn in 128, 256, 512, 1024 m
